verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at help.getzep.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured docs index, and a versioned v3/llms.txt also exists. The docs pages are served as raw markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can read them directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent or community reports of agents actually using these docs.
